info.title: Get Order Split Attributes
info.description: Use this API to check whether an order(s) can be split into multiple packages or not.

get.description: Use this API to check whether an order(s) can be split into multiple packages or not.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: order_ids
parameters.description: Query list of TikTok Shop order IDs.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

can_split.description:
Whether an order can be split:
- `true`: The order can be split into multiple packages.
- `false`: The order cannot be split into multiple packages.

reason.description: The reason why the order cannot be split. Only return this field when `can_split = false`.

must_split.description:
Whether an order must be split:
- true: The order must be split into multiple packages.
- false: The order does not have to be split into multiple packages.

type.description: It will return which type of verification is hit. There are two types of verification: CATEGORY_ITEM_LIMITATION means category verification and TOTAL_COUNT_LIMITATION means total product quantity verification.

category_id.description: If the value of reason.type is "CATEGORY_ITEM_LIMITATION", this field will return a value. If the value of reason.type is "TOTAL_COUNT_LIMITATION", this field will return no value

max_count.description: For category verification, return the maximum quantity of goods allowed for this category in a single package; for total product quantity verification within the package, return the total quantity limit of goods in a single package.

must_split_reasons.description: The reason why the order must be split. Only return this field when must_split = true.

split_attributes.description: Specific return information (can return multiple TikTok Shop order IDs).

Specific return information (can return multiple TikTok Shop order IDs).

Whether an order can be split:
- `true`: The order can be split into multiple packages.
- `false`: The order cannot be split into multiple packages.
The reason why the order cannot be split. Only return this field when `can_split = false`.

Whether an order must be split:
- true: The order must be split into multiple packages.
- false: The order does not have to be split into multiple packages.
The reason why the order must be split. Only return this field when must_split = true.

It will return which type of verification is hit. There are two types of verification: CATEGORY_ITEM_LIMITATION means category verification and TOTAL_COUNT_LIMITATION means total product quantity verification.
If the value of reason.type is "CATEGORY_ITEM_LIMITATION", this field will return a value. If the value of reason.type is "TOTAL_COUNT_LIMITATION", this field will return no value

For category verification, return the maximum quantity of goods allowed for this category in a single package; for total product quantity verification within the package, return the total quantity limit of goods in a single package.
